<span id="_1-概述"></span>
# 1. Overview

Data preparation, which includes data access and modeling, is the foundation of data visualization analysis. Typically, users need to perform data access before conducting visualization analysis.

Data connection is the first step in connecting to a database. After completing this step, you can create datasets to serve as inputs for data visualization queries and analysis, or as inputs for visual modeling. Visual modeling refers to basic data processing, data cleaning, and modeling operations performed on existing data. The processed datasets can then be used for data visualization queries and analysis. IT personnel, data engineers, or data analysts typically perform more operations during the visual modeling stage.

<span id="_2-模块入口"></span>
# 2. Module entry points

In the top bar of the product interface, click "Data Preparation". The dropdown menu includes: Data Connection, Visual Modeling, and Datasets. Click any entry point to access the corresponding module. As shown in the following figure:

<span id="_3-模块简介"></span>
# 3. Module introduction


* [Data Connections Overview](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataWind/Data_Connections_Overview): Creating a data connection can be understood as creating a credential for connecting to a database and accessing data tables. By creating a data connection, you can quickly obtain table information from the database, create datasets, and then process or clean input tables during visual modeling.

* [Dataset Overview](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataWind/109947): A dataset is the foundation for carrying and managing data in Intelligent Data Insights, and also serves as the basis for visual queries and analysis. In simple terms, it can be regarded as a type of data table. Users need to create datasets from the source tables to be analyzed before performing subsequent modeling, visual chart creation, dashboard creation, and other tasks. In the dataset module, you can create, edit, and manage datasets.

* [Visual Modeling Overview](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataWind/109972): is the data processing and modeling capability provided by Intelligent Data Insight. This capability is commonly referred to as ETL (Extract\-Transform\-Load), and can also be called data modeling. As an intermediate link between data sources and visualization display, visual modeling enables users to efficiently process initial datasets in a user\-friendly, intelligent, drag\-and\-drop manner before performing visual queries and dashboard creation, so that after data is cleaned, transformed, and loaded, the resulting datasets are more conducive to business analysis. At the same time, this module also supports capabilities such as model training and algorithmic prediction.


The above provides a brief introduction to the three modules. For more information, please refer to the individual documentation for each module.
